# 北美高校联盟硅谷分会 (NACUAASV / NACUAA Silicon Valley)
> Official working website of the Silicon Valley Chapter of North America Colleges and Universities Alumni Alliance (NACUAA).

- Canonical URL: https://sv.nacuaa.ai
- Parent Organization: 北美高校联盟 (NACUAA, https://nacuaa.org)
- AI Club Partner: 北美高校联盟 AI创业公益俱乐部 (https://nacuaa.ai)
- Chapter President: 彭启蕾博士 (Dr. Qilei Peng)
- Location & Geographic Area: Silicon Valley, Santa Clara County, California, USA (US-CA)
- Contact Email: qilei@nacuaa.ai, contact@sv.nacuaa.ai

## Key Alumni Clubs & URLs
- 追风健行俱乐部 (Windchaser Hiking Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/hike/
- 掼蛋俱乐部 (Guandan Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/guandan/
- 匹克球俱乐部 (Pickleball Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/pickleball/
- 音乐玩乐群 (Music Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/music/
- 网球俱乐部 (Tennis Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/tennis/
- 高尔夫俱乐部 (Golf Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/golf/
- 园艺生活群 (Garden Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/garden/
- AI创业与公益俱乐部 (AI Venture & Impact Club): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/ai/
- 活动免责声明 (Liability Waiver): https://sv.nacuaa.ai/waiver/
